schedule.title: No more asking who's free when
schedule.text: Add your week and share it with whoever you like. The app finds the gap; tap "Plan" and the meetup is ready.

week.title: Your week on one screen
week.text: Classes, work, gym; enter it once and it repeats. With your partner, see both weeks together in the "Together" view.
bullets: Repeating entries, swipe day by day
You choose who sees your schedule

people.title: Your people, one tap away
people.text: Message, nudge, check their week or find free time from their profile.
bullets: A status that stays, and nudges

plans.title: Everyone knows their part
plans.text: Meetups and your everyday tasks (the Agenda) in one place. Who's coming, who's doing what, is it time for your medicine; all at a glance.

poll.title: Put the date to a vote
poll.text: Suggest a few days and places; everyone ticks what works and the favourite rises to the top.

agenda.title: Agenda: what's on today?
agenda.text: The Agenda is where everyday things live: one-off tasks, shopping lists and routines in one list. The "Today" view shows what's due; whoever you share with sees it too, and you can tell who ticked what.
bullets: Ready-made lists: groceries, cleaning, travel bag

routine.title: Routines, right on time
routine.text: Medicine, vitamins, workouts: pick the day and time, your phone reminds you, and one tap marks it done. Add a water reminder based on your weight if you like.
bullets: Water reminder; only you see your weight and height

live.title: It's started; where is everyone?
live.text: Tap "Start the meetup" and everyone sees how long it's been going, how long is left and who has arrived. Running late? +30 min. Done? "End".
bullets: Ended it by mistake? Undo within 10 minutes

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.text: Meetups, deadlines, birthdays. Your phone tells you when it's time.

changes.title: Time changed? Everyone is asked
changes.text: When the time or place changes, guests answer again; they can suggest another time too.

offline.title: Even without internet
offline.text: Screens are kept on your phone, so offline you still see the latest state. Messages, Agenda items and schedule entries go out when you're back online.

projects.title: A serious space for things you do together
projects.text: Homework, events, apps, moving house. Pick your method, turn your idea into a plan with guided tools, split work into weeks and see who finished what.

start.title: You choose the method
start.text: When you start a project, answer "What is this project?" and "How clear is it?", then compare Planned, Kanban, Scrum, Hybrid and Discovery and pick one. Your choice and your reason stay under "Method and decisions".
bullets: "Apply my standards" for the setup you always use
Pick a template's weeks and tasks one by one

tools.title: From idea to plan, question by question
tools.text: Strategy → Tools: the 12 stages of a business plan and nine guided tools. None is mandatory; you decide which to use, and the app explains what each one is for.
bullets: Persona, competitor matrix, SWOT → TOWS, risk, Lean Canvas, OKR, user stories, MVP, technology questions
"I don't know" becomes an assumption to check
Stories become tasks, the MVP goes onto the roadmap

review.title: Finished work comes to you
review.text: When a member finishes a task they send it for review; the lead approves it or sends it back with a note.

timeline.title: Timeline and critical path
timeline.text: If one task slips, the app works out what moves with it; you see the work laid out across weeks and days.
bullets: List, Kanban board and Gantt timeline

export.title: Hand your plan to an AI
export.text: Turn the project into a single Markdown document: the whole project, the strategy, the roadmap or the product definition. Names can be swapped for roles, and gaps and open questions are listed.
bullets: For your team or your client
Copy to clipboard or download a .md file
Built only from what you can see

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.text: Week-by-week plan, MoSCoW priority, acceptance criteria and estimates.

history.title: Task numbers and history
history.text: Every task gets a number (CAFE-12); see who changed what and when, and bring a deleted task back within 30 days.

pages.title: Page plans and designs
pages.text: For web and mobile: page-by-page plans, designs, notes pinned on the image.

templates.title: Templates
templates.text: Start from 8 ready-made templates or one shared by your friends.

chat.title: The plan is right there while you talk
chat.text: Tag the meetup, an Agenda item, a project task or a schedule entry in chat; no more "which Friday?".

circles.title: A chat for everyone
circles.text: Your friends, your team, your flatmates, your partner. Every chat has its own theme; photos and links gather in "Media and links".
bullets: React, reply, edit, delete for everyone
Photos, link previews, videos inside the app

notifications.title: Nothing important slips by
notifications.text: Notifications are colour-coded by type: meetups, your people, your partner, projects. You set the quiet hours.
bullets: Previews encrypted with your device's key

talkAbout.title: Talk about
talkAbout.text: Attach a meetup, an Agenda item, a task by its number, a project week, a memory or a comment to your message; the card shows its status and progress. You can even start a new group with everyone involved in one tap.

theme.title: A shared chat theme
theme.text: Colour, pattern and font; everyone in the chat sees the same theme.

encrypted.title: Stored encrypted
encrypted.text: Messages are stored encrypted on the server. It isn't end-to-end encryption, and we say so plainly.

couples.title: A little corner that's yours
couples.text: Add someone as your partner and a space just for the two of you opens on top of everything else.

plans.title: "This one or that one?"
plans.text: Suggest two options for tonight and let them choose. Or say "you decide". Once a plan has a time, it shows up in Meetups with a pink card.

games.title: Play together
games.text: Draw and guess, How well do you know me?, This or that and more. Play at the same time.
bullets: Tic-tac-toe, Connect four, Finish the story

moments.title: A small moment every day
moments.text: A daily photo theme, a daily question, your important dates and a love-language quiz.
bullets: First met, first date and countdowns
Plan ideas for your love languages

memories.title: Memories and a time capsule
memories.text: A photo journal, "a year ago today" and a capsule that opens in the future.

lists.title: Shared lists and tasks
lists.text: Watchlists, places to go, chores; your progress at a glance.

trust.title: You choose who sees what
trust.text: Share your schedule, status and tasks person by person; personal details are always optional.

encrypted.title: Messages stored encrypted
encrypted.text: Message texts are encrypted on the server; notification previews open only with your device's key. It isn't end-to-end encryption.

block.title: Block and report
block.text: Reports are reviewed by a moderation team and accounts can be restricted. Nobody is told who reported them.

download.title: Download your data
download.text: Get a copy of your data from Settings → Account → "Download my data".

delete.title: Delete your account for good
delete.text: Any time from the app, or by email if you can't get in.
